description: Defines the LanguageService interface for managing language entities, including methods for retrieving language data by code, obtaining language maps, converting between Language objects and Locales, and extending generic service functionalities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity based on its code, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language entities, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Provides a list of all available Language entities, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object to a corresponding Locale.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Locale object to a Language entity.
